verdict.rationale: Every project is a full Postgres database built on open-source tools, and it can be self-hosted with Docker Compose. That implies the data lives in a standard, portable format and can be moved off the managed platform. Backups are documented, and community evidence notes they are nightly pg_dump dumps, a standard open format. However, the pack has no first-party documentation of a user-facing export or migrate-away workflow. missing for 10: documented export procedure (e.g., pg_dump/CSV download), export of Auth users and Storage files, a migration-off-platform guide, independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.
